── bio ──

Ryan van der Heijden is a researcher specializing in water resources, machine learning, and complex systems science.

Postdoctoral associate at the University of Vermont, working with the Cooperative Institute for Research to Operations in Hydrology, and NOAA funded consortium of government, academic, and private entities striving to improve the state-of-science in national water modeling.
